title: Microsoft Purview DLP: reusable global lists for Exchange Online rules
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap dates, existing Exchange DLP controls and product-level licensing are supported, and targeted searches found no documentation for reusable lists. Two statements go beyond the evidence: that existing rule actions are preserved and that editing a list changes matching without editing rules. The existing-policy navigation and checklist coverage also need minor corrections.

claims.claim: DLP creation and deployment require one of the five named role groups or the documented granular permissions.

The account you use to create and deploy policies must be a member of one of these role groups:

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft Purview portal path reaches Add condition in an Exchange DLP rule creation wizard.
claims.quote:
On the Define policy settings page, the Create or customize advanced DLP rules option should already be selected.
Select Next.
Select Create rule. Name the rule and provide a description.
Under Conditions, select Add condition > Content contains.
claims.fix: Include the omitted wizard page and preselected option: Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Enterprise applications & devices > Custom > Custom > Exchange email > Define policy settings > Create or customize advanced DLP rules > Create rule > Conditions > Add condition. The cited procedure supports this route.
